Author: Minescence
Name: Fur Renderer
Description: Grows hundreds of thousands of skinned hair strands on any chosen item or minion based on their texture or material, and draws them with the GPU. Follows the dye and the scene's light. Only you see it.
Changelog: Fixed a dark line down the middle of the fur trims where they face the camera, which moved along as the camera moved. It came from the "Partings" setting, which is now a checkbox that is off by default. Turn it on in the settings for the deeper partings of the reference look.
